description:
Implement TPC-H Skew benchmark based on the research published at
https://www.tpc.org/tpctc/tpctc2011/slides_and_papers/introducing_skew_into_the_tpc_h_benchmark.pdf
and reference implementation at https://github.com/YSU-Data-Lab/TPC-H-Skew

ARCHITECTURAL CONSTRAINT: TPC-H Skew is ONLY responsible for the skewed data variant.
For comparative analysis (uniform vs skewed), the existing TPCHBenchmark must be used
for uniform data generation and execution. Do NOT duplicate TPC-H functionality within
TPC-H Skew - instead, orchestrate both benchmarks when comparison is needed.
